name: 极简构成
direction: Radical minimal geometric identity. A compact TD monogram created from one black solid T and one semicircular D bowl with a very clever shared negative space, extremely few shapes, architectural optical balance. Black ink on pure white with one tiny vermilion accent. Flat vector artwork, absolutely no dimensional effects. Quiet museum-design identity, spacious composition. Small ToolDawn wordmark in restrained modern sans.

name: 瑞士字构
direction: Swiss international typographic identity. Oversized custom uppercase TD in tightly kerned heavy neo-grotesk letterforms, a rectangular T crossbar precisely intersects a tall D; unmistakable TD, typographic not pictorial. Deep ultramarine and signal yellow with a bold offset rectangular field, asymmetric editorial composition and strong grid. Flat vector graphic, crisp print-like precision. Small ToolDawn wordmark in neutral grotesk, flush left.

name: 锐角疾速
direction: Extreme angular futurist TD ligature. Broad razor-cut strokes, engineered chamfers, diagonal negative-space channels, compact fast silhouette and sharp terminals. Acid yellow-green against graphite black with white wordmark. Flat two-dimensional silhouette, no gradients, no chrome. Distinctive cyber-industrial graphic design, athletic motion without generic swooshes. Small custom angular ToolDawn wordmark.

name: 复古典藏
direction: An elegant nineteenth-century inspired TD intertwined monogram: expressive high-contrast serif letters, bracketed serifs, graceful swash on the T integrating into a handsome D, both clearly readable. Wine red and warm ivory with subtle printed-ink character, sophisticated book-publisher identity, not wedding calligraphy. Large monogram on uncluttered ivory background, small ToolDawn wordmark in refined serif. No badge or ornamental frame.

name: 自由签名
direction: A bespoke lowercase td signature mark drawn in one confident black brush gesture, dynamic calligraphic thick/thin rhythm, one long t cross-stroke and open-loop d, both readable. Black expressive ink on pale apricot with a small electric orange accent. Fashion atelier meets creative studio, asymmetrical airy composition. Clean ToolDawn wordmark quietly below. Not a generic script font; a striking custom hand-lettered logo.

name: 像素街机
direction: Authentic bold 8-bit TD monogram built entirely from sharp square pixels on a disciplined low-resolution grid, chunky connected letterforms clearly read T and D. Electric purple, neon pink and bright cyan against midnight purple, strictly hard pixel edges, no smooth curves, no glow or gradients. Retro arcade cartridge identity, compact silhouette. ToolDawn wordmark in matching legible pixel lettering. No game controllers or extra icons.

name: 工业钢印
direction: Brutalist condensed TD stencil monogram, huge narrow industrial letterforms with intentional broad stencil bridges and one utilitarian cutoff. Matte black ink on safety orange, controlled worn screenprint edges but letters remain clean enough to identify. Tough workshop tooling brand rather than software default. Small ToolDawn label in industrial condensed typography, raw frontal graphic layout, no actual physical object, no mockup scene.

name: 液态银铬
direction: Sculptural liquid-chrome lowercase td monogram with readable connected t and d forms, substantial inflated metal strokes, polished silver reflections, a few purposeful molten curves, luxurious experimental digital art. Large monogram floating alone on a deep cobalt studio backdrop; small crisp white ToolDawn wordmark below. High-end realistic 3D material rendering, controlled reflections and soft contactless shadow, avoid extra blobs, no unrelated objects. Silhouette should still clearly read td.

name: 光学玻璃
direction: Refined translucent optical-glass uppercase TD monogram, two thick architectural glass letterforms partially intersect with visible cyan-to-lilac refraction and subtle warm peach internal reflections. Clearly readable T and D, squared yet softly polished edges, airy luminous white studio backdrop with realistic soft caustics. Premium 3D product-render material study, not cartoon plastic or jelly. Small understated dark-purple ToolDawn wordmark. No extra objects.

name: 街头涂写
direction: Bold original TD graffiti handstyle monogram, broad expressive marker strokes, controlled overlaps, energetic uneven baseline, unmistakable T and D, youthful graphic streetwear identity. Hot orange and saturated magenta with black keyline on a light lilac background. Crisp artistic vector-like lettering with a few purposeful paint flicks, not messy illegible wildstyle. Small clean contrasting ToolDawn wordmark. No mascots, stars, smileys or stock symbols.
